title: [GAP-8] A user's devices have no way to sync private data or history
description: Review finding GAP-8: A user's devices have no way to sync private data or history (lens GAP). Location: spec/14-jmap.md:59, 81, 115; spec/02-identity.md:84-86, 208-232; spec/05-messaging.md:107. Fix: Partly covered. §14.3.1 (14:81) allows "a personal daemon run by or for that member" serving the member's own devices. Where one is used, it is the sync point for `ReadPosition` and `ChatContact`. The gap remains for daemon-less clients. A related gap the finding misses: no procedure says who adds a newly enrolled device's leaf to every group the user is in. Enrollment ends at the KeyPackage upload (02:381), and 02:229 only says "having an existing device add it". For DMs, it is also unstated whether the §4.6.1 consent threshold applies to a member's own new device. The backup-fork risk is real and unaddressed. 02:220 exports "Current MLS key material for all group memberships", and nothing forbids using it alongside the source device. Fix as proposed, and add the new-device group-join duty (the user's existing devices commit Adds for their own new device, exempt from DM consent). Full text: notes/review/GAP-verified.md and notes/review/GAP.md.
